gjort: Nothing to translate or upload today. All 13 rows in SE-ACTIVE to be translated already carry their Norwegian ad - the mirroring round put them live - and each one was read back from Meta as ACTIVE in an ACTIVE ad set.

CS_107_H1, CS_108_H1, GT_107_H1, GT_108_H1, GT_110_H1, RI_102_H1, RI_103_H1, CO_103_H1, TR_103_H1, OB_101_H1, OB_102_H1, PD_106_H1, PD_107_H1 -> CaraShellRoof_NO_<name> in CARASHELL_NO_Takovertrekket.
All 13 stay in SE-ACTIVE to be translated on purpose: they move to Approved once the US round carries them too. No Notion status was touched.
The campaign is ACTIVE with 12 ad sets, the inherited link is carashell.se/nb/products/takskyddet?country=NO, and the store price reads 1 106 NOK.

Fixed a false negative in the queue: GT_4_1 has been reported as missing its Norwegian ad since 2026-09-17, and it is not missing. It has been live as CaraShellRoof_NO_G_4_1 since 2026-09-14, because the gift angle is coded GT in Sweden and G in Norway. The queue now looks for the market's own concept code before calling a row missing, so the same creative cannot be uploaded twice under two names. Approved rows missing a Norwegian ad: 1 before the fix, 0 after.
varningar: The uploader can no longer create a second ad set for an angle that already exists under a concept code differing by one letter (G vs GT). It stops and says so instead. That rule was written in the product memory on 2026-09-14 and was repeated anyway on 2026-09-18 - a rule in a file is not a rule in the code.

Both gift ad sets are now live in the same CBO and were measured today: CARASHELL_NO_Takovertrekket - G holds 4 ads, 2 246,04 kr, 5 purchases; - GT holds 7 ads, 2 470,82 kr, 4 purchases. Nothing was paused, moved or renamed - ads that are already live are never switched off after the fact.
Meta cannot move an ad between ad sets, so this cannot be merged without rebuilding ads. The queue now reports the split on every run until the owner decides.
action_axel: Decision needed on the gift angle in Norway: it runs in two ad sets in the same CBO. Option A: leave both running and read G + GT together in analysis (nothing is lost, the CBO still optimises across them). Option B: pause one - the owner's call, since both carry spend and purchases. Recommendation: A. New gift ads keep going into - GT, where the seven newest ones already are.
